summary: End-to-end testing of admin dashboard (backend auth + admin APIs and frontend /admin UI) against ingress URL https://design-spaces-luxury.preview.emergentagent.com. 17/17 pytest backend cases passed and all 10 critical frontend flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is still `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=True` — browsers will ignore credentials, fine today since JWT is sent via Authorization header, but tighten origins before going to production (just in case cookie-based auth is added later).
JWT is stored in localStorage (XSS-exposed). For a luxury-brand admin panel with PII access, consider httpOnly cookie + CSRF once a second user type is added.
No pagination on GET /api/admin/leads (to_list(1000) hard cap). Fine while lead volume is low, but will silently truncate at 1000.
Brute-force lockout key is `{ip}:{email}` — an attacker iterating many emails from the same IP is not throttled. Consider an IP-only counter in addition.

Stats `this_week` comparison works only because `created_at` is stored as ISO8601 string and lexicographic order matches chronological for the same timezone/format. Fragile if the format ever changes (e.g., losing the 'Z' suffix); consider storing as BSON Date.

Admin email/password comparison in login is plain `find_one({email})`; lowercased correctly on input, but the seed path stores `ADMIN_EMAIL` already lowered — good. `EmailStr` in AdminLogin does a basic format check — good.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* and UI_Probe_* leads during the run. Cleaned up afterwards: 11 test leads and 0 login_attempts remaining (login_attempts were also cleared by fixture teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin auth + admin APIs + admin UI all fully functional via ingress. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py covers login success/failure, 5-attempt brute-force lockout (uses fake email nobody-bf@example.com so real admin is never locked out), /admin/me auth matrix, /admin/leads listing (sorted desc + no _id leak), PATCH toggle + 422 invalid status + 404 unknown id, /admin/stats shape + auth, public POST /api/leads still works, and that the old unauthenticated GET /api/leads now returns 404/405. Frontend Playwright flow covered: ProtectedRoute redirect, wrong-password toast, successful login, stat cards populated, search filter, WhatsApp link (https://wa.me/91<10digit>?text=...prefilled...), filter tabs, mark-done status toggle with live stats refresh, and logout clearing ssi_admin_token. If any admin endpoint is changed, re-run pytest; otherwise no retest needed.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found this iteration. The previously noted 'logger before definition' issue in /app/backend/server.py is now resolved — logger is declared on line 45 and routes start at line 150.
